myproxy_server_port.description: TCP port the MyProxy server listens on for incoming credential requests.

myproxy_server_host.description: Host IP address or hostname the server binds to.

myproxy_server_cred_dir.description: Directory where user credentials are persistently stored.

myproxy_max_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime (in hours) allowed for stored credentials.

myproxy_min_lifetime.description: Minimum lifetime (in hours) required for newly stored credentials.

myproxy_default_lifetime.description: Default lifetime (in hours) applied when no explicit lifetime is requested.

myproxy_delegate.description: If enabled, allows users to delegate credentials.

myproxy_server_cert.description: Path to the server's X.509 certificate file.

myproxy_server_key.description: Path to the server's private key file.

myproxy_ca_certs.description: Path to the directory containing trusted CA certificates.

myproxy_log_file.description: Path to a dedicated log file.

myproxy_ssl_engine.description: Path to the OpenSSL engine module (optional).
